vv66:1.1: Yathā vanaṃ Cittalataṃ pabhāsati uyyānaseṭṭhaṃ Tidasānam uttamaṃ tathūpamaṃ tuyham idaṃ vimānaṃ obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe. || ||
vv66:2.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv66:3.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv66:4.1: Ahañ ca bhariyā ca manussaloke opānabhūtā gharam āvasimha annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacittā sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adamha.
